test_grouping_note: Records 201 and 202 belong to the same subject and are kept in one split group.
lead_selection: Prefer MLII, then II, otherwise the first available lead; records 102 and 104 used V5.
evaluation_note: Single GroupShuffleSplit holdout with random_state=42. AAMI-inspired five-class mapping; paced records are included, so this is not a strict EC57 benchmark. Educational baseline, not for clinical use.
model: StandardScaler + distance-weighted kNN (k=5), six basic signal statistics
confusion_matrix_order: Rows are actual classes; columns are predicted classes in labels order N, S, V, F, Q.
